No generalization beyond the finite range is claimed.

value.rationale: Contiguous universality is the defining property of de Bruijn cycles; best-cut subsequence universality is a distinct natural strength of that same object. Order five is the first order with nonconstant optimal-cut strength, establishing an exact qualitative boundary. The full 2048-cycle and 528-symmetry-class classifications quantify the split and provide independently reproducible data, not a single arbitrary numerical example.
